text: Quick check: What is the site for the depot where label printing stalled in the carrier API outage at Tansley Parcel? Thank you!
reply_text:
I replied to Tobias in the thread: the depot was **Southgate**.

On 3 Sep 2025, Priyanka posted in #inc-tansley-carrier-api that label printing had stalled at Tansley Parcel depots, with Southgate dispatch holding totes stacked beside door 4. Her note at 18:43, when she closed the incident, says Southgate cleared the backlog. No other depot is named in the channel, and I couldn't find a street address for the site in any of the shared files.

Tobias is a member of that channel, so everything I used is something he can see himself.
